known.via: English Wikipedia "Pla de Bages" (a wine place on Wikidata)

communes: Pont De Vilomara I Rocafort, El

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A Catalan DO in Barcelona province, one of the smallest in Spain at under 1,250 acres and one of the newest, official since 1997. Allowed grapes include Picapoll Blanco and Picapoll Negro, plus Macabeo, Parellada, Tempranillo and Merlot.
